events.name: Bash
events.input: cat docs/decisions/README.md && ls docs/decisions && git log --oneline | head -10 && cat scripts/prune-snapshots.sh && head -30 CHANGELOG.md

events.output:
# Architecture decisions

This log records the choices a reader of the code would otherwise
second-guess: what we picked, why, and what it costs us. A one-line code
comment is enough for everything else.

## Format

Each entry lives at `docs/decisions/NNNN-kebab-title.md`, numbered
sequentially from...

# 0002. Prune snapshots older than 30 days

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Date:** 2025-11-18

## Context

Nightly snapshots accumulate on the backup volume until something deletes
them. The volume holds roughly four months of snapshots, and nobody has
ever asked to restore from one more than two weeks ...
